Getting Started with PowerShell

PowerShell is a cross-platform task automation solution made up of a command-line shell, a scripting language, and a configuration management framework.

Common Cmdlets

To inspect active processes on your computer, administrators often use the Get-Process cmdlet.

Get-Process | Where-Object WorkingSet -gt 100MB

To test network connectivity and download web content in scripts, PowerShell provides Invoke-WebRequest:

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos" -OutFile "repos.json"

Running PowerShell

You can launch PowerShell from the Windows Start menu or by pressing Windows Key + X and selecting Windows PowerShell.
